en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad, from Amro Bin Sabit, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Washing your hands in one vessel would improve your manners’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from ‘Amr ibn Thabit who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Wash your hands in one utensil; it is good for the betterment of your moral behavior . 555
